title: Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: Builds and configures its own databases, analysis programs, simulation pipelines, and testing environments.
body:
Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem. Builds and configures its own databases, analysis programs, simulation pipelines, and testing environments.

This database covers the technology as item 214 entry 8 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (A)" catalog, section "Omega Intelligence". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Self-configuring infrastructure is real (IaC, AutoML); a research ecosystem that builds itself is emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Builds and configures its own databases, analysis programs, simulation pipelines, and testing environments.
body:
Known science foundations of Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem.

Infrastructure-as-code provisions environments automatically. AutoML configures pipelines. CI systems build test environments. JAH's own database network grows via builders. An ecosystem that designs its databases, analyses, simulations, and tests from research goals is the frontier.

Key quantity check (Environments provisioned per day by IaC in thousands / manually provisioned): computed ratio 10 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Builds and configures its own databases, analysis programs, simulation pipelines, and testing environments.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem.

Self-built components need verification. Configuration errors propagate. Research goals are ambiguous.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 4 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is auto-provisioned vs manual at 4 orders of magnitude (auto-provisioned larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

Unresolved problems for Self-Constructing Research Ecosystem, in priority order (research burden index 17, 1 blocking):

From goals to infrastructure (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Verifying self-built stacks (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

Debugging self-built systems (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).
